OFFICE ORDER

Sub.: Constitution of Committee on NFU — reg. .

The undersigned is directed to convey that a committee on NFU is constituted with
following members:

(i) Sh. R.K.Kukreja, ACC-I

(ii) = Sh. A.K.Gupta, ACC-II

(iii) | Sh. Navendu Rai, RPFC-II
(iv) Sh. Paritosh Kumar, RPFC-II

This NFU Committee is advised to scrutinize the relevant records with reference to
DOPT instructions, examine ACRs/APARs, vigilance status and recommend the eligibility
date with relevant pay scale/ grade pay to officers of EPFO in accordance with NFU
provisions within 30 days.

\B

(SHARMA)

All officers as above.
